clips.title: The story
paras: On Teldrassil, Tallonkai's Jewel is lost from its druidic talisman. Ferocitas the Dream Eater prizes the emerald, which is needed to mend the Emerald Dreamcatcher.

Tallonkai Swiftroot received the Emerald Dreamcatcher from Gaerolas Talvethen, warden of the druids in the Ban'ethil Barrow Den. The talisman is a powerful focus that draws energy from the Emerald Dream. When it was damaged, someone pried its radiant central emerald free and carried it into eastern Teldrassil. Ferocitas the Dream Eater, a corrupted Gnarlpine leader, took the jewel and made it into a necklace. Its green light glimmered in the forest gloom, but its harmony with the Emerald Dream meant nothing to the furbolg. To Ferocitas, it was only a trophy until it could be recovered.
